about: BlendSession vectors: scripts of frame-tagged inputs with the frame-tagged actions and events each step must give. The shared Kotlin session and the OctoKit Swift session both run every script. The expected values were worked out from the rules, never captured from a run. The format is described at the top of BlendSessionVectorsTest.kt.

vectors.name: crossfade-blends-end-to-end
vectors.about: Arm in the run-up, B ready, the start found ahead, proposed at the floor plus the margin, acked, committed at the floor, ended at A's frame at the blend end.

vectors.name: not-ready-at-the-start-then-one-later-blend
vectors.about: B not ready at the start: incoming not ready, A disarmed at S. The re-plan (start 182000) arms at once, B is ready 800 ms after the first S, and exactly one blend follows. A stale acknowledgement of the first generation fails.

vectors.name: late-arm-without-a-bar-grid-moves-to-the-lead
vectors.about: Armed 200 ms before startMs: S would be 19200 frames ahead of the head, under the 26160 lead. The start moves to A's song time at the head plus the lead, 180145, and the blend runs from there.

vectors.name: an-unlocked-plan-that-may-not-move-re-plans
vectors.about: The same late Crossfade with a budget of 0 (an unlocked plan whose both-heard stretch would break if moved): no move, incoming not ready; the re-plan from the head arms at 182000 and is not moved.

vectors.name: an-unlocked-plan-that-may-not-move-has-no-hold
vectors.about: An unlocked intro with a budget of 0: B dry inside A's hold gets no extension and goes straight to the clean cut at its return.

vectors.name: incoming-dry-in-a-blends-lead-in-rejoins-on-a-bar
vectors.about: A plain blend with a silent lead-in (holdShare 0.25 of 8 s: A holds to 2000) is held like an intro: B dry 1 s in is placed one bar on (624000), and the blend ends one bar later, B's own time there the unextended 8000.

vectors.name: a-speed-drop-cuts-where-the-beats-would-part
vectors.about: Beats lock at 1000 with a gap of 0.0025 over both-heard 1000 to 13000 (30 ms at the end, within 40). The pace drops to 0.5 at blend time 4000, inside A's hold (to 7000): the bound is now 20 ms, first broken at lock + 20 / gap = 9000, so A keeps its hold and the clean cut lands there, 480000 frames on at half speed.

vectors.name: a-raise-before-the-drop-cut-clears-it
vectors.about: The same drop, then the pace back to 1 at blend time 6000: the bound (40 ms, lock + 16000) is never broken inside the stretch, so the cut is cleared and the blend runs to its end at 1248000.

vectors.name: a-speed-drop-never-cuts-inside-the-hold
vectors.about: Beats lock at 12000 with a gap of 0.0025 over both-heard 1000 to 13000. The pace drops to 0.25 at blend time 4000, inside A's hold (0.6 of 14000, to 8400): the bound is now 10 ms, broken everywhere before lock - 10 / gap = 8000, so without the hold A would be cut at once. A keeps its hold, and from its end the beats stay within the bound to the stretch's end, so there is no cut and the blend runs to its end at 672000 + 10000 * 192 = 2592000.

vectors.name: a-hold-extension-delays-the-drop-cut
vectors.about: The drop at blend time 2000 schedules the cut at 9000. B then stalls at blend time 3000, inside the hold, and is placed one bar later (2000 ms, 192000 frames at half speed): the cut lands at 1440000 instead of 1248000, and B's own time there is 9000.

vectors.name: late-arm-on-the-bar-grid-moves-a-bar
vectors.about: The same late arm for a rate-matched plan with a 2000 ms bar (moves allowed): the start moves to A's first bar line at least the lead ahead, 182000.

vectors.name: late-arm-with-no-room-is-not-ready
vectors.about: The next bar (182000) plus the 2000 ms overlap ends after latestEndMs 183000: incoming not ready, A plays on.

vectors.name: late-arm-of-a-plan-that-allows-no-move-is-not-ready
vectors.about: A locked plan with no rate and a tempo gap (its drift bound depends on where it sits) armed late: no move, incoming not ready, although the next bar would fit.

vectors.name: a-late-move-of-three-bars-is-refused-with-two-allowed
vectors.about: Armed with A already 4 s past startMs: the first bar line the lead allows (186000) is 3 bars on, over the plan's budget of 2, so incoming not ready. The same start under a budget of 3 moves there.

vectors.name: a-late-move-of-two-bars-is-made-with-two-allowed
vectors.about: Armed with A 2 s past startMs: the first bar line the lead allows (184000) is 2 bars on, within the plan's budget of 2, so the start moves there.

vectors.name: a-hold-is-capped-at-the-plans-one-bar
vectors.about: The hold of the intro vector with a budget of 1 bar: the room deadline is one bar from B's stop (720000) instead of three, B is not ready by then, so A's blend time unfreezes there (2000 ms) and B's return is the clean cut.

vectors.name: a-placement-lands-on-the-fewest-whole-bars
vectors.about: A 2000.01 ms bar is 96000.48 frames. B stops at 624000 (room for 3 bars, deadline 912001) and is ready at 815521, so the earliest placement is 816001. Two bars land at 624000 + round(192000.96) = 816001, which is that earliest frame: B is placed there with 4000.02 ms added, never a third bar on because 192001 is a hair over two bars' 192000.96 frames. A's end is posted at 180000 + 14000 + 4000.02 ms, frame 1344001, where B's own time is the unextended 14000.

vectors.name: a-placement-past-the-budget-takes-the-clean-cut
vectors.about: The one-bar budget of a-hold-is-capped-at-the-plans-one-bar: the room deadline is 720000. B is ready at 719000, before the deadline's check (720000 less the 480-frame horizon), inside an output step to 720480, so the earliest placement is 720480. The fewest bars landing there are two (816000), past the deadline: A's blend time unfreezes at 720480 (2010 ms on), as the deadline would have, and B, ready, comes in at once by the clean cut there. The budget is never overspent.

vectors.name: a-late-move-spends-the-budget-a-hold-would-use
vectors.about: An intro plan with a budget of 1 bar armed late moves its start one bar (182000). B then stalls inside A's hold: the budget is spent, so there is no room and no extension (no freeze); B is held and comes in by the clean cut.

vectors.name: outgoing-rebuffer-before-a-start-that-may-not-move
vectors.about: The rebuffer 0.6 s before S of a locked, no-rate plan with a tempo gap: when S can no longer be decided the lead ahead, incoming not ready instead of a move; A plays on.

vectors.name: outgoing-rebuffer-before-the-start-moves-it-a-bar
vectors.about: A runs dry 0.6 s before S while armed: the plan stays armed through the stall. A refills at real time, so S can no longer be decided the lead ahead of the head: the start moves to the next bar, then blends.

vectors.name: a-deck-pause-while-armed-disarms
vectors.about: A's own pause with frames left in the run-up disarms (cancelled, posted at once while the output is paused); so does B's under the next generation.

vectors.name: incoming-dry-while-armed-waits-for-the-start
vectors.about: B dry in the run-up changes nothing until the start, where it is not ready.

vectors.name: a-released-spare-output-keeps-the-blend
vectors.about: The spare's output released and a new one on the same slot (a re-seek): it buffers, then plays. No input is a failure, the registration is kept and the blend starts.

vectors.name: outgoing-moves-on-before-the-start
vectors.about: A reaches its real end early (or its queue changed): cancelled, A plays on into its own next song, B never starts.

vectors.name: outgoing-stream-ends-before-the-start
vectors.about: A's stream ends with nothing after it before the start: cancelled.

vectors.name: a-decoded-end-before-the-start-cancels-at-once
vectors.about: A's decoded end is known at 456000 (song time 179500), before the start at 180000: at the first advance after it the predicted start (480000) lies past it, so the plan is cancelled there as A's own advance, before A's next pass is reached.

vectors.name: a-late-move-past-the-decoded-end-cancels
vectors.about: The rebuffer of the bar-grid vector, with A's decoded end known at 528000 (song time 181000): the late start would move the start to the next bar (182000, frame 576000), past that end, so instead of moving the plan is cancelled as A's own advance.

vectors.name: a-start-found-past-the-decoded-end-cancels
vectors.about: A's decoded end (470000) and then A's frame at the start (480000) come in one advance: the start lies past the end, so the plan is cancelled at the start's input as A's own advance and nothing is proposed.

vectors.name: floor-cancel-when-the-proposal-is-not-answered
vectors.about: Proposed, main never acks: at the cap floor the audio thread cancels, B's start is undone, incoming not ready is queued at S, and main's late ack fails.

vectors.name: a-late-start-is-cancelled-at-the-floor-unproposed
vectors.about: The head is already inside the floor at the first check after the start was found: no proposal, the floor cancels from the initial state.

vectors.name: floor-cancel-after-the-outgoing-song-passed-its-end
vectors.about: A's real end 5 ms after startMs, mixed ahead: its next pass is held and the blend ends there. Main stalls past the floor: the cancel mixes A's held next pass at once with no follow-up asked, and the queued blend end (past S) is dropped.

vectors.name: an-edit-in-the-unheard-window-undoes-the-start
vectors.about: Main's interrupt cancels the proposed word, then disarms: B's start is undone and A is back at its own level. The first follow-up answer wins, a second is ignored, and main's stale ack fails.

vectors.name: an-undo-with-no-follow-up-asks-one-block-later
vectors.about: A already passed its end when the undo arrives and no answer comes: one block later follow-up needed is posted at once; the first answer then wins.

vectors.name: an-unanswered-undo-holds-the-outgoing-end-then-asks
vectors.about: Undone mid-song with no answer yet: when A later moves on, its next pass is held, and one block later follow-up needed is posted.

vectors.name: an-edit-after-the-handover-with-the-written-point-before-s
vectors.about: Acked, then an edit while the written point is still before S: A plays alone to S and B enters there disarmed with the 20 ms ramp (the cut at S), so no silence opens before B.

vectors.name: an-edit-after-the-handover-past-s
vectors.about: An edit 500 ms into the blend after the handover: A leaves with 20 ms, B disarms over 250 ms, the limiter window ends after B's ramp; easing starts at B's 500 ms.

vectors.name: airplay-quiet-start-commits-before-the-ack
vectors.about: A quiet start on a route whose delay exceeds 1 s commits at its deadline while only proposed; an interrupt before main's ack fades B over 250 ms and brings A to its own level.

vectors.name: incoming-dry-in-an-intro-hold-rejoins-on-a-bar
vectors.about: B stalls 3 s into a 14 s intro (hold to 0.75): B is held and A's blend time frozen; the room deadline is three bars on. B is ready at 718080: past the 480-frame horizon the next bar from B's stop is 720000, one bar of extension. The extended blend ends at 196000, and easing starts at B's song time since entry over the rate there: 14000, the unextended overlap, since B consumed nothing while held (16000, overlap plus extension, is wrong).

vectors.name: the-same-hold-with-the-iphone-horizon
vectors.about: The same stall and readiness with a 2880-frame horizon (50 ms time-pitch latency plus a render cycle): the first bar past the horizon is 816000, two bars of extension.

vectors.name: repeated-stalls-in-the-hold-add-up
vectors.about: Two stalls inside the hold, each placed one bar on: the extension adds to 4000 ms, the second room deadline counts the first extension, and the blend ends at 198000.

vectors.name: a-stall-with-no-bar-grid-rejoins-at-the-horizon
vectors.about: An unlocked intro (hold to 0.7 of 12 s): B is placed at its ready frame plus the horizon, 696480, and the extension is that span, 1510 ms.

vectors.name: a-hold-with-no-room-takes-the-clean-cut
vectors.about: Inside the hold but one bar of extension would end after latestEndMs 195000: no room, so B is held until it is ready and comes in by the clean cut at its ready frame plus the horizon.

vectors.name: incoming-dry-past-the-room-deadline
vectors.about: The room deadline is two bars on (816000). B is not ready by then: A's blend time unfreezes at the deadline (4000 ms moved), and B's later return is the clean cut.

vectors.name: incoming-dry-while-the-outgoing-fades
vectors.about: B dry in a crossfade: A plays on along its fade and B is held; at B's return A leaves and B comes in from where it stopped, one cut 20 ms each.

vectors.name: incoming-stalled-past-the-fade-simply-comes-in
vectors.about: B is still dry when A's fade ends: the blend ends at A's end with B disarmed, and B's return later needs nothing from the session.

vectors.name: outgoing-dry-in-the-mixed-stretch-ends-the-blend
vectors.about: A stalls inside an intro hold: the blend ends at the mix point, B to its own level over 250 ms, the rest of A's hold lost to its stall; B going dry afterwards is a plain rebuffer.

vectors.name: outgoing-moves-on-in-the-mixed-stretch
vectors.about: A's real end comes 3 s before the planned blend end: its next pass is held unmixed, the blend ends there and B goes to its own level over 250 ms.

vectors.name: outgoing-stream-ends-in-the-mixed-stretch
vectors.about: A's stream ends with nothing after it before the planned blend end: the blend ends there, nothing to hold.

vectors.name: both-decks-dry-the-first-decides
vectors.about: B dry first (A fading, so B is held for the cut), then A dry: a plain rebuffer. B's return is the cut.

vectors.name: a-disarm-while-held-for-placement
vectors.about: After the handover, an edit while B is held in the hold: A leaves with 20 ms, B is released and disarmed over 250 ms; easing starts at B's stopped point.

vectors.name: a-deck-pause-before-the-ack-is-an-undo
vectors.about: B's own pause with frames left after its start was mixed and proposed, before main's ack: the session cancels the word itself, undoes the start, and posts its cancel and follow-up needed at once. Main's ack fails; the first answer wins.

vectors.name: a-pause-after-the-ack-with-s-not-consumed
vectors.about: Paused after the handover with the settled head before S: re-mixed from the consumed point as A alone to S, then B alone from S with the 20 ms ramp; the blend end posts at once.

vectors.name: a-pause-after-the-ack-with-s-consumed
vectors.about: Paused 150 ms after S reached the settled head: B alone from its consumed point, disarmed over 250 ms, nothing of B heard twice.

vectors.name: a-deck-pause-after-the-ack-takes-the-pause-rule
vectors.about: A's own noisy pause after the handover, settled 150 ms past S: the same re-mix as the person's pause.

vectors.name: incoming-fails-in-the-run-up
vectors.about: B's player error before the start: unregistered, A plays out alone.

vectors.name: incoming-fails-before-the-ack
vectors.about: B fails after its start was mixed, before the handover: main cancels, the failure carries the follow-up, B's start is undone and A's own deck plays B's song by its own advance.

vectors.name: incoming-fails-after-the-handover
vectors.about: B fails mid-blend after the handover: A leaves with 20 ms and the blend ends; the error goes on to the service.

vectors.name: outgoing-fails-in-the-run-up
vectors.about: A's player error before the start: unregistered, B never starts; the service's own skip plays B's song once.

vectors.name: outgoing-fails-before-the-ack
vectors.about: A fails after B's start was mixed, before the handover: main cancels, B's start is undone, no follow-up is asked.

vectors.name: outgoing-fails-after-the-handover
vectors.about: A fails mid-blend after the handover: the blend ends at the mix point, B to its own level over 250 ms.

vectors.name: the-end-never-posts-before-the-start
vectors.about: A runs dry 100 ms after S while the start is mixed ahead and not yet proposed, with the head 400 ms or more behind: the blend end is queued first, but events post in frame order, the proposal first, the end only once its frame passes the head.

vectors.name: events-of-a-cleared-stretch-post-at-the-clear
vectors.about: The blend end is queued for a frame the head has not reached; a clear that removes that stretch posts it at once.

vectors.name: an-edit-in-the-run-up-disarms-before-the-start
vectors.about: Main cancels the initial word and disarms before B's start was mixed: B never starts, A plays on at its own level.

vectors.name: main-cancels-an-unproposed-start
vectors.about: B's start is mixed but not yet proposed (initial): main's interrupt cancels it and the start is undone; no proposal follows.

vectors.name: iphone-inputs-in-bus-order
vectors.about: iPhone, 0 ms time-pitch latency: B dry, then A dry (a plain rebuffer), then B's return as the cut at its ready frame plus the 480-frame horizon.

vectors.name: iphone-inputs-interleaved-from-both-renders
vectors.about: The same inputs with A's render ahead: A's dry arrives before B's earlier dry, and the session advances only to the lower rendered bus frame, so the outcome is the same.

vectors.name: iphone-inputs-interleaved-with-50-ms-latency
vectors.about: The interleaved inputs with 50 ms time-pitch latency: the 2880-frame horizon puts the cut at 530880.

vectors.name: iphone-restart-re-places-a-committed-start
vectors.about: An engine restart after the commit re-places S at 482400, still outside the 3360-frame commit deadline: B simply starts there, committed.

vectors.name: iphone-restart-inside-the-deadline-moves-a-bar
vectors.about: The restart re-places S at 479520, inside the commit deadline (head 478080 plus 3360): the committed start moves to A's next bar line, 182000 at 575520, never off the beat.

vectors.name: iphone-restart-moves-the-fewest-whole-bars
vectors.about: A 2000.01 ms bar is 96000.48 frames. The restart re-places S at 289439, more than a bar before the head (478080), with room for 3 bars before the latest end 190000. The commit deadline 481440 is 192001 frames on, a hair over two bars' 192000.96, and two bars land at 289439 + round(192000.96) = 481440, the deadline itself: the committed start moves two bars, to 184000.02 at 481440, never a third bar on (186000.03 at 577440).

vectors.name: iphone-a-mapping-change-in-the-run-up-re-places-the-start
vectors.about: A's time-pitch latency turns on (50 ms) after the start is decided at 480000 and before it is proposed: A tells the new frame as restarted, and the start is re-placed there, uncommitted. It is proposed 7680 frames before 482400 (474720) and, acked, committed 2880 before it (479520). A's song runs 50 ms later from the restart on, so the blend ends with it at 182000, frame 578400.

vectors.name: iphone-restart-inside-the-deadline-without-a-grid
vectors.about: The same restart for a Crossfade: the start moves to the placement horizon, 480960, and A's start time with it (180030).

vectors.name: iphone-restart-with-no-bar-before-the-end-cuts
vectors.about: The next bar line (182000) is past A's end (181800): B starts at the horizon by the clean cut, so no silence opens before B.

vectors.name: iphone-restart-of-a-plan-that-allows-no-move-cuts
vectors.about: The same restart inside the deadline for a plan with no bars to move (lateMoveBars 0): the committed start cannot be cancelled, so B starts at the horizon by the clean cut.

vectors.name: iphone-restart-without-a-grid-past-the-latest-end-cuts
vectors.about: The restart of iphone-restart-inside-the-deadline-without-a-grid with latestEndMs 182010: moving A's start to the horizon (180030) would end the blend at 182030, past it, so B starts at the horizon by the clean cut instead.

vectors.name: blend-at-half-speed
vectors.about: 0.5x, the margin at its 1 s cap (lead 66960 frames), armed at the earlier of the run-up start and the lead plus a 500 ms ready lead: 177500. The 1.8 s blend arms and blends.

vectors.name: crossfade-at-half-speed
vectors.about: 0.5x with the 2 s Crossfade.

vectors.name: blend-at-1.25x
vectors.about: 1.25x, armed at 177500 (2 s of output before S): the 1.8 s blend arms and blends.

vectors.name: crossfade-at-1.25x
vectors.about: 1.25x with the 2 s Crossfade.

vectors.name: blend-at-1.5x
vectors.about: 1.5x: the lead plus the ready lead (2842.5 ms of song time) is earlier than the run-up start, so it arms at 177157.5, 1895 ms of output before S; the 1.8 s blend blends.

vectors.name: crossfade-at-1.5x
vectors.about: 1.5x with the 2 s Crossfade.

vectors.name: blend-at-2x
vectors.about: 2x with the margin at its cap: the run-up start alone is only 1.25 s of output, so it arms at the lead plus the ready lead (3790 ms of song time, 1895 ms of output) and the 1.8 s blend blends.

vectors.name: crossfade-at-2x
vectors.about: 2x with the 2 s Crossfade.
